Description: Authentic Windows LSASS Event Log Ingestion (Phase 1 evtx-auth-sample.json)
BoundaryRationale: Ingests 5 authentic Event 4625 records generated by native advapi32!LogonUserW into LSASS; proves real OS telemetry triggers threshold breach.
Single failure represents baseline noise; threshold (>=5) is not breached.

Description: Sub-threshold failure burst at boundary N-1 (4 failures in 90 seconds)
BoundaryRationale: N=4 is exactly 1 attempt below threshold; rule must suppress alert.

Description: Exact threshold breach (5 failures in 120 seconds)
BoundaryRationale: N=5 reaches threshold of 5 within 5 minutes; alert MUST fire.

Description: Above-threshold failure burst (6 failures in 100 seconds)
BoundaryRationale: N=6 exceeds threshold of 5 within 5 minutes; alert MUST fire and record continuous breach.

Description: Temporal sliding window enforcement (5 failures spaced over 400s / 6.7 minutes)
BoundaryRationale: Total events is 5, but max events within any 300s sliding window is 4; temporal window prevents false positive.

Description: Machine account failure burst (5 failures for 'LAB-SRV01$')
BoundaryRationale: Machine accounts ending with $ are excluded by DET-01-PRIM; alert MUST NOT fire.

Description: Horizontal password spray (5 failures within 60s targeting 5 distinct users)
BoundaryRationale: DET-01 groups by TargetUserName. Each account has N=1 failure; single-account brute-force rule must NOT fire.
